verdict.rationale: Supabase ships a dashboard-integrated AI Assistant for natural-language database management (supabase-docs-41, supabase-docs-19). It also offers an official MCP server and plugin that let AI assistants query the database, manage migrations and deploy Edge Functions on the user's behalf (supabase-docs-1, supabase-docs-2), and a runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint is live with OAuth (supabase-probe-rt-2). The community prompt-injection discussion shows agents acting on project data through MCP, and Supabase acknowledges prompt injection remains an unsolved risk (supabase-comm-1, supabase-comm-2). Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of a successful end-to-end natural-language session, and detail on the scope and limits of the dashboard AI Assistant's commands.
